sloka: तस्य भूमौ शयानस्य पादौ प्रक्षाल्य लक्ष्मणः ।सभार्यस्य ततः अभ्येत्य तस्थौ वृष्कम् उपाश्रितः ॥२-५०-४९॥
transliteration: tasya bhūmau śayānasya pādau prakṣālya lakṣmaṇaḥ ।sabhāryasya tataḥ abhyetya tasthau vṛṣkam upāśritaḥ ॥2-50-49॥

translations.english: Then Lakshmana washed the feet of Rama and his wife as they lay upon the ground, and withdrawing, stood leaning against a tree.
